querySql:
select 
                                      object_id,
                                      s_info_windcode,
                                      s_profitnotice_date,
                                      s_profitnotice_period,
                                      s_profitnotice_style,
                                      s_profitnotice_signchange,
                                      s_profitnotice_changemin,
                                      s_profitnotice_changemax,
                                      s_profitnotice_netprofitmin,
                                      s_profitnotice_netprofitmax,
                                      s_profitnotice_number,
                                      s_profitnotice_firstanndate,
                                      s_profitnotice_abstract,
                                      s_profitnotice_reason,
                                      s_profitnotice_net_parent_firm,
                                      s_info_compcode,
                                      s_profitnotice_changemin_ded,
                                      s_profitnotice_changemax_ded,
                                      s_profitnotice_ni_min_ded,
                                      s_profitnotice_ni_max_ded,
                                      s_profitnotice_netprofit_ded,
                                      opdate,
                                      opmode,
                                      to_char(sysdate - 1, 'yyyymmdd') as bath_dt,
                                      cast(sysdate as timestamp) as data_ins_time,
                                      'w_ashareprofitnotice.json' as task_rs_id
                                from ${srcoradbname}.ashareprofitnotice WHERE s_profitnotice_period BETWEEN '${busi_month}'||'01' AND to_char(add_months(to_date('${busi_month}'||'01','yyyyMMdd'),1)-1,'yyyyMMdd')
